description: Baseline MATCH plus a field projection.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS user_name $$) AS (user_name agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name AS user_name))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name AS user_name))
